intro: Event planner workflow automation is the most effective way to recover the 18 hours you lose to manual administrative tasks every week. By moving away from fragmented spreadsheets and disconnected apps, you can stop the cycle of repetitive data entry and focus on the creative side of event production.

blocks.text: You likely feel the weight of administrative tasks every single day. Between vendor contracts, attendee lists, and budget trackers, your computer time is often spent moving data from one place to another. Research shows that 68% of event professionals report exhaustion from this fragmented tool usage. When you rely on manual reconciliation, you introduce human error into every step of your process.
Why your current workflow causes burnout

The primary issue is the fragmented tech stack. You might use one app for registrations, another for budgeting, and a third for communication. Because these tools rarely talk to each other, you become the bridge. You spend your time copying names from an email into a spreadsheet, then moving that data to your project management tool. This is not just tedious. It is high-risk. About 68% of event failures are traced back to poor preparation and planning gaps caused by these manual handoffs.

items: Consolidate your stack: Use a single platform for registration and task tracking to eliminate manual data entry.
Standardize your templates: Create master documents for run sheets and vendor contracts. Never start a new event document from scratch.
Automate the small stuff: Use built-in triggers in apps like Asana or Trello to send automatic reminders for vendor payments.
Centralize communication: Keep all project discussions inside your project management tool instead of buried in long email threads.

blocks.text: How Lazur fits your Mac workflow

Lazur acts as a voice-powered assistant that lives in your Mac notch. It does not click buttons for you, but it helps you get through your apps faster. If you are stuck in a complex Google Sheet, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask Lazur how to apply a filter. It will talk you through the steps. If you need to draft an email to a vendor, hold fn and dictate the message directly into Gmail. Lazur keeps your focus on the event, not on finding menus.
Managing your time during the week
Success comes from a routine that separates deep planning from administrative maintenance. Try this schedule to protect your focus.

faq.question: Can Lazur automate my vendor emails?
faq.answer: Lazur cannot send emails for you. However, you can use it to draft your responses quickly by dictating them, ensuring you spend less time typing and more time planning.

faq.question: Does Lazur work with all my event planning apps?
faq.answer: Lazur works on your Mac screen. It can guide you through any app that runs on macOS, including Chrome, Safari, Gmail, and Google Sheets.

faq.question: Is my event data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. Lazur only sees your screen and hears your voice when you hold the shortcut keys. Your content is never used to train AI models.
